controls.summary: Keep a created task launch-pending until an authoritative full task observation confirms its state; omission from a partial or limited list is not failure evidence.
evidence: A limited task-list response omitted an active issue #60 Luna task.
A subsequent full task-list response confirmed the task was active in its generated worktree.

controls.summary: Check model authority before any mutation and stop all orchestration, protected planning or governance work unless the active model is Sol Extra High.
evidence: Protected orchestration design began while the active model was Terra Medium.
Repository model governance permits Terra to read protected planning but forbids it from materially creating, editing, approving, or restructuring that planning.

controls.summary: Capture operational lessons automatically as local candidates, but adopt durable controls only through evidence, an issue, Sol Extra High approval, tests, and a protected pull request.
evidence: Chat memory did not reliably preserve prior task-launch semantics.
Repository-owned controls can be validated and applied by every future task and heartbeat.

controls.summary: Advance a launched implementation only after its authoritative task record proves the requested model, generated worktree and exact accepted base SHA.
evidence: A task creation requested a commit before the protected remote-tracking ref had been fetched locally.
The successful issue #60 task was confirmed only after a full task observation exposed its real task ID and generated worktree.

controls.summary: Before dependent delivery, prove live GitHub connector, exact SSH refs, credential-safe CLI reads and an authenticated protected write path; record each action class and keep browser authentication explicitly user-controlled.
evidence: Installed GitHub plugin files remained present while the live connector disappeared from a prior task, so installation metadata did not prove mounting.
Repository ownership, public reads and SSH pushes succeeded while the stored CLI credential was denied issue updates and pull-request mutations.
